troubleshooting.solution: Check Inclusive vs Exclusive mode. Inclusive includes current point, Exclusive starts from 0.
Ensure Input Attribute Scope matches the attribute you want to accumulate.

description: Creates running sums (integrals) of attribute values. For each point, the output is the sum of all previous points' values. Two modes: Inclusive (includes current point) and Exclusive (excludes current point).
